findings.issue: The About action lookup combines two loops and two conditions across two unbraced lines, producing four nested control-flow levels for a simple widget search.
findings.fix: Expand the outer widget loop with braces, assign the QMenu cast, and continue when it is null. Keep the inner action loop and matching assignment, including its existing last-match behavior; do not add a break or otherwise change the lookup result. This lowers nesting and makes ownership of the action loop obvious.

efficiency.scope: The 19 files listed in work/versioning/review-paths.json, using review.patch and the faithful /tmp/putgd-version-review checkout

findings.inefficiency: Every ordinary build writes a temporary manifest, reads it through configure_file, and removes it even when identity is unchanged. The final output already correctly preserves its timestamp, but the temporary-file round trip is unnecessary.
findings.concrete_fix: Replace the final file(WRITE), configure_file(COPYONLY), and file(REMOVE) calls with file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${OUTPUT_DIR}/build-info.json" CONTENT "${manifest}\n" @ONLY). This retains write-only-on-content-change behavior and the exact manifest bytes while removing the temporary-file operations.

notes: The always-run Git refresh is required to detect commits and working-tree changes; skipping it based solely on existing outputs would change behavior.
Generated C++ uses configure_file, which avoids recompilation when identity is unchanged.
Packaging and install validation are safety checks and should remain intact.
Repeated parsing of the small immutable manifest on explicit diagnostics/About requests does not justify additional cache state in this scope.
No new unbounded resource retention, listener leak, blocking application startup work, or worthwhile concurrency change found.
